tabs.sub: Three videos built around the moment we want Kenetik known for: focus late in the day, without the jitters, the crash or a wrecked night. Everything you need to film them is on this tab.

blocks.text: Three hooks, three videos, about an hour of filming. Everything you need is on this page.
The fast version

**Every one of these is about the same moment:** it’s late, there’s still work to do, and you want to lock in without paying for it tonight. One video owns **the late lock-in**, one gets you **off the caffeine treadmill**, one is about feeling **calm, not wired**. Any can works for any of them. **Whichever you film, say what time it is.**

steps.title: Video 1 · The Late Lock-In: it’s evening, and you’re still getting it done
steps.text: **What it is about:** the hour most people write off. Film it at night, crack the can, say the time, and get to work.

steps.title: Video 2 · Off the Caffeine Treadmill: coffee to wake up, more to keep going, then no sleep
steps.text: **What it is about:** the loop everyone knows. Name it, say how you got out, and what you drink instead.

steps.title: Video 3 · Calm, Not Wired: focus without the jitters
steps.text: **What it is about:** the difference between locked in and buzzing. Say what too much caffeine feels like for you, then show the other version.

steps.title: Say “shop now” out loud in all three
steps.text: Then post them close together, not spread over a month. The detail on each one is below.

blocks.label: Read this before you film
blocks.text: We update this page as the numbers come in. If what is here has changed since you last looked, **film whatever is live now**. You will never be marked down for filming the current three.
The one thing every winner has in common

**Make these your own.** The three below are starting points, not scripts. Every video that has worked for us sounds like the person who made it. Every video that has flopped sounds like an ad read. Say these in your words, in your cadence, with your reason, and if a line here is not something you would actually say out loud, change it. **We would rather have your version of the hook than our version in your voice.** **And the story is always yours, not ours.** Each of these is about a person and the change in their day. Kenetik is what made it possible, never the hero.
How we picked these

blocks.text: Videos 2 and 3 grow out of the two openings that have sold best for us: **the switch off caffeine** and **saying what Kenetik is not**. Video 1 is the moment our best customers describe when they tell us why they buy. We put budget behind whichever one your audience responds to, and **top videos graduate into our paid ads, where you earn commission again**.

steps.title: Film it at the actual time
steps.text: Evening light, real clutter, the laptop or the workbench. Do not shoot this at noon and pretend.

It grows out of our most repeated winning framing, **saying what Kenetik is not.** Here the contrast is a feeling everyone knows: buzzing, scattered, heart racing. **Calm and locked in is the answer**, and you can show it in a single shot.

Two minutes of checks that are worth more than another hour of filming.
The one line most people forget

Say **“shop now”** out loud. Saying your call to action rather than only putting it on screen is one of the strongest signals in our shop data, and **“shop now” is the one phrase that works everywhere we run your video**, on TikTok and in our paid ads. It costs you one second.**Say those two words and stop there.** Do not name the orange cart, the basket, or anything “below” the video. Your best videos get run again as ads on Facebook and Instagram, where none of that exists, and a cart line is the one thing that stops a good video being reused. **“Shop now” travels. “Shop the orange cart below” does not.**

layout.text: **Kenetik is metabolic brain fuel.** A caffeine-free drink with 12g of ketones, the same fuel your body makes when you fast or sleep. It gives you calm, clear focus that comes on steady: **no jitters, no anxious edge, no crash.** Sugar-free, nothing artificial, Informed Sport Certified.

Most people hit a point in the day where there’s still work left and the tank is empty. The usual fix is another coffee at 3pm or a can of something loud at 8. It gets the job done, then you’re wired, you can’t switch off, tomorrow starts tired, and you reach for more. **Kenetik is the drink for that moment: lock in late, finish strong, and with no caffeine in the can, nothing in it is keeping you up once you’re done.** That’s the moment we own, and it’s the one every video should carry.

**You know your audience better than we do.** Take that late-day moment and tell it the way your people talk: your evening, your words, your reason. Your viewer is the hero and Kenetik is what made the difference, never the star. Two things every video does: say **“brain fuel”** and **“shop now”** out loud. One thing none of them do: medical claims.

_doc.hooks_are_a_library: hook_id is frozen for the life of a line so proof accrues to the line, not to a copy of it; a tab holds an ordered list of placements (hook_ids).
_doc.unknown_is_never_zero: A line no video has been read against carries UNKNOWN on every proof field and says so in its own how.
_doc._who_writes_what: The turn (scripts/flywheel_turn.py through scripts/cs_helpers/flywheel_hub.py) writes top_now, hooks[].proof, hooks[].rules, hooks[].angle_id_proposed and rules_version on every run, and changes_pending on a decide run, and nothing else. `updated` stays editorial: a machine refresh must never restate a date a person set. rules_version MOVED from editorial to machine on 2026-09-16 (workplan 7-3): it was editorial only because nothing wrote it, and every publish now re-runs the rule reader over every row against the current references and stamps what the rules were. The console's deliberate write lane (kind hook_swap) is the only writer that moves a placement: it applies one approved swap, appends the receipt to decisions and stamps hooks[].entered.
_doc._wins_figure_is_machine: A Top 10 card's figure MOVED from editorial to machine on 2026-09-24 (build-spec-angles.md Phase 1, decision 5). tabs[top-10-now].layout[wins].items[].sales is the turn's own figure for that card's video: its TikTok Shop sales and order count over the turn's window, written weekly by scripts/cs_helpers/flywheel_hub.py write_wins_figures with the same rule as every machine field (a new date alone is not a change). The renderer draws it in place of items[].figure and items[].note, which stay exactly as Nick set them and show only on a card the machine has no figure for. Nick's words on each card (tag, quote, handle) are his and the machine never writes them. Since 2026-09-28 (L-441) the Top 3 and Start Here cards carry the same record, because both say, beside their cards, that the figure is what that video sold on TikTok Shop over the last 90 days, which is the turn's own measure; the renderer draws each record with the dates of its window. A card whose video the turn cannot see carries no record, and hooks_hub_validate lists it (card_figure_without_a_record). No Meta figure is ever written onto this page: sales.source is always tiktok_shop, and hooks_hub_validate refuses any other source or any Meta-named figure.
_doc._a_proposal_is_never_an_edit: A line the turn proposes is added to hooks{} with no placement and named in changes_pending; the gate accepts an unplaced line, because a proposed, a declined and a displaced line are all legitimately on no tab, and it refuses a placement that points at no line. Only an approval on the console puts it on a tab, in the place of the row named in `out`.
_doc._the_angle_is_nicks_words: hooks[].angle is Nick's own free text about the line and is editorial: the turn never reads or writes it. hooks[].angle_id_proposed beside it is the machine's proposal, an id from the angle list in config/creator-flywheel-hooks.json, sorted from the line's own words (L-441, 2026-09-24). Nothing applies a proposal; approval waits for a later phase.

_extraction.attribution_convention_found: an a.hsrc link in a hook's meta line, carrying the creator's handle and their TikTok video URL; every unmarked line is recorded as composed
